relations.relation: locate and extract the passage(s) where research aims, objectives, or hypotheses are stated
locate the passage(s) stating the research problem or motivating need, distinct from the aims statement
judge whether the extracted aims/objectives/hypotheses statement is worded clearly and specifically rather than vaguely or generically
compare the scope implied by the aims statement against the stated problem/need to assess whether that scope is justified (neither over- nor under-reaching)
locates the explicit statement(s) of research aims, objectives, or hypotheses within the text
determines whether the located statement names concrete variables, populations, or predicted directions rather than vague generalities
determines whether the statement is expressed in unambiguous, well-formed language free of undefined or overloaded terms
links the stated scope of the aims to a supporting rationale (e.g., gap or motivation) elsewhere in the text
distinguishes each objective from its corresponding hypothesis/prediction where applicable
locate and segment the text unit(s) in the document that assert the research problem, objectives, or hypotheses/predictions
differentiate objective/problem statements from hypothesis or prediction statements within the segmented span, where both are present
assess whether the segmented statement is expressed in unambiguous, comprehensible language
assess whether the segmented statement names concrete scope, parameters, or conditions rather than generic or vague terms
connect the stated scope/need of the aims to surrounding motivation or context text that warrants that scope

metric.name: Clarity and specificity of research aims/objectives/hypotheses
metric.text: The research problem and objectives (and hypotheses/predictions where appropriate) are stated clearly, specifically, and at a justified scope/need.
